environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running in us-east-1, IMDSv1 enabled, instance profile attached with role 'ServiceRole-Production' that has s3:*, dynamodb:*, and iam:PassRole permissions. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No network ACL restrictions on metadata endpoint. Instance runs in a public subnet with IGW attached.
